notes: DeepSeek Harness stores every current durable event as one physical JSONL row inside a checksummed Zstandard frame. The recipe requests the tokenizer-efficient literal dequeueReusableCellWithIdentifier exactly 300 times with single spaces, which is a deterministic 10199-character text payload and about 305 output tokens. The exact transcript assertion requires the entire payload in one assistant/message text block and rejects tool calls, so a short response cannot satisfy only the lifecycle arc. The DSH adapter is single-birth. The shared tailer validates and decodes the frame, then applies the 64 MB line cap. This live row is a sanity check, not a true cap stress. The same UUID session must complete ready to working to ready with no waiting transition. The fixed model supplies non-zero usage and has no local price mapping.
